question: How do I search Plantour for something?

items: Open the toolbar features menu with the bars icon and select Search.
Start typing into the search box. Plantour updates the results automatically while you type.
Open any result card to jump to the matching page.
sections.afterHtml: You can also share or reopen a search by using the page URL with its query parameter, because Plantour keeps the current search text in the search page address.

sections.title: What Plantour searches
items: Public Plantour pages such as Home, Contact, Terms, and Privacy.
Help pages and help questions that are marked as searchable.
Public packing templates, including template-related details loaded for the search index.
sections.afterHtml: In the current implementation, this search is for Plantour pages and public template/help content. It is not a global search across your private trips, personal items, personal todos, or other account data.

sections.title: Useful option
items: Use the page menu to switch between Show Highlights and Hide Highlights if you want the matched text in results to be emphasized or plain.
